Subject: MAP kickoff: POC seed & peering rundown

Hi Jared — great to be moving forward. Per our call this morning, attaching an initial MAP workbook and a short activation rundown so your infra and security teams can action the POC environment items in parallel. High-level asks below; please assign owners and confirm ETA in a reply.

Key POC seed items we want in the MAP (target: two-week runway after org setup):
- Org onboarding: create a tenant/organization in our test namespace and invite acme-poc-admin@acmehealth.com (SAML optional)
- API keys: request 2 scoped keys (one read-only for metrics, one generate for dev) with expiration 30 days; include client_id and redirect if integrating service accounts
- IP allowlist: provide CIDR ranges (primary + DR) and internal testing CIDRs; list NAT/public egress IPs for token exchanges
- VPC peering: provide VPC ID, region, and route table owner; we’ll supply peering request from Redwood side once we have peering contacts
- Test workload: simple tokenized generation test (10k tokens/day limit) and an embeddings burst test

Please see the attached MAP_seed_v1.xlsx for a row-level timeline. Suggested milestone cadence: org invite + API keys (Day 0), allowlist and peering contacts (Day 1–2), peering established & smoke tests (Day 3–5), validation and sign-off (Day 10–14).

Attachments: MAP_seed_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) and SOW_draft_redwood.docx (editable).

Quick ask from you in reply: 1) who will be the network owner for peering requests, 2) the preferred maintenance window for peering (if any), 3) CIDRs we should allow for the test tenant.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
